name: wander-armenia
description: Wander Armenia - places worth visiting across Armenia. Monorepo: Express API + React web app.
author: Avet Badalyan

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix api install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix api run dev:demo" "npm --prefix web run dev"
